step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Visioning: We'll start by diving deep into…
step.text: Initial Consultation and Visioning: We'll start by diving deep into your creative brief. This means discussing the type of work you'll do, the equipment you need, desired acoustics, power requirements, and even potential loading arrangements. This initial 'LineWork' phase is crucial for defining the scope and ensuring we capture your unique needs.

step.name: Step 2: Integrated Design and Engineering: Unlike traditional models, our t…
step.text: Integrated Design and Engineering: Unlike traditional models, our team coordinates architectural design and structural engineering concurrently. We'll produce floor plans and architectural drawings that integrate your technical requirements, from soundproofing to specialized power circuits, ensuring buildability from the start.

step.name: Step 3: Permit Navigation and Zoning: Dealing with local zoning and permitt…
step.text: Permit Navigation and Zoning: Dealing with local zoning and permitting can be complex. We handle the heavy lifting, navigating the necessary approvals for your studio, especially in areas like San Marino or Pasadena where regulations can be specific to ADU projects. This includes everything from site and utility coordination to obtaining necessary building permits.

step.name: Step 4: Transparent Project Management: Throughout construction, you'll hav…
step.text: Transparent Project Management: Throughout construction, you'll have clear visibility. We use digital project-management tools to keep you updated on budgets, schedules, progress photos, and next steps. This organized control means you're always in the loop, reducing friction and protecting the design intent.

step.name: Step 5: Quality Construction and Craftsmanship: Our 'Development' phase foc…
step.text: Quality Construction and Craftsmanship: Our 'Development' phase focuses on meticulous execution. This includes custom cabinetry, millwork, appliance integration, and ensuring seamless transitions between new and existing structures. We prioritize construction quality and the practical usability of the finished space.

step.name: Step 6: Final Walkthrough and Completion: As we near completion, we conduct…
step.text: Final Walkthrough and Completion: As we near completion, we conduct thorough inspections and address any punch-list items. The goal is a turnkey delivery, providing you with a fully functional, inspiring creative studio that aligns perfectly with your original vision.
